evidence_against.relevance: Casey consistently initiated contact and arranged approximately weekly one-on-one time over twelve weeks.
Casey provided practical support for an important interview and attended a birthday dinner Drew considered important.
Casey independently resumed regular contact after two periods of geographic separation.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Casey twice declined to define the relationship and offered no timeline for revisiting the issue.
Meetings were usually convenient for Casey or arranged at short notice, and Casey canceled two advance plans for other commitments.
Casey has not integrated Drew into close social or family circles and declined a future event because it required planning two months ahead.

recommended_action.explanation: Drew can state the level of commitment and planning desired and ask whether Casey is willing to revisit defining the relationship within a concrete timeframe.

uncertainty_explanation: Casey's sustained initiation, weekly contact, support, and reconnection show real interest, but the repeated avoidance of definition, limited advance planning, convenience-centered meetings, cancellations, and lack of social integration more strongly support low-commitment involvement.
